name: JW Marriott St. Maarten Beach Resort & Spa
positioning: Beachfront resort on Dawn Beach, on the Atlantic side of St. Maarten, with plunge-pool rooms, a 16-treatment-room spa and a heated sea-facing pool
best_for: Couples who want a beachfront room with a private plunge pool
Families who want kids' programs and a pool with a children's area

facts.text: The resort is set on Dawn Beach in St. Maarten.
The resort is about 30 minutes from Princess Juliana International Airport.
Room types include beachfront rooms with a balcony and a private plunge pool.
The Hibiscus Spa offers a steam room and separate men's and women's lounges.
The pool area has towel service and a dedicated children's area.
Cabanas are set directly along Dawn Beach.
Carambola serves seafood-led dinners beneath open-air colonnades overlooking the shoreline.
Liguria is a Mediterranean restaurant with a wine list ranging from French roses to Italian reds.
Live music plays on the Lower Pool Deck three nights a week, with Latin, Caribbean, steel pan and French performances.
Programs for children ages 3 to 12 offer hands-on activities such as arts and crafts, garden exploration and culinary classes.
Resort activities include sunrise yoga, water aerobics and a rooftop pickleball court.
Guests can sail through the America's Cup 12 Metre Challenge or on sunset sails to nearby cays.

highlights.text: The resort sits on the Atlantic edge of Dawn Beach, where soft sand curves into clear turquoise water bordered by green hillsides.
Guest rooms and suites have private patios, balconies, open decks and private plunge pools.
The Hibiscus Spa has 16 specialty treatment rooms and a relaxation area.
The heated outdoor pool faces the sea and has a swim-up bar.
The JW Culinary School runs hands-on cooking and mixology sessions in small groups.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
The resort is about 30 minutes from Princess Juliana International Airport.
WhataHotel notes that hurricane season may affect travel plans.
